title: Support $τ$-tilting modules over Morita context algebras: A bilateral approximation approach
summary: Let $k$ be a field and let $Λ=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}A&N\\M&B\end{smallmatrix}\right)_{φ,ψ}$ be a finite-dimensional Morita context algebra. We introduce a bilateral approximation construction which glues support $τ$-tilting modules over $A$ and $B$ by alternately correcting the two corner components through minimal approximations and pushouts. When this process terminates, it yields a support $τ$-tilting $Λ$-module with the prescribed componentwise torsion class.
